messages:
maya-cs: Quick sync: Stonehaven reserved pool go-warm scheduled TOMORROW 09:00 PT. We need quota confirmation, autoscale policy review, and a short loadtest. @tom-eng @raj-sre @shelly-ops please confirm owners. Also pinging @anita-billing for quota bump sign-off.

anita-billing: Confirmed billing approved quota bump for the warmup window (one-off). I'll send the invoice note and tag finance.

tom-eng: I'll run the dry-run. Plan: shadow traffic 30m at 60 r/s, then blue-green cut with ramp 60->300 r/s over 12m. We'll keep constant request sizes and pinned model `rdx-5b-serve-v2` to match expected latency.

maya-cs: SLA guardrails: p99 < 1.2s. Abort criteria: p99 > 2s for 5m OR error rate > 4% sustained for 3m. Raj, do SRE checks align?

raj-sre: Aligns. Autoscale suggestion: min_replicas=1, target_cpu=60, max_replicas=25, scale_up_window=90s, add temporary headroom +3 replicas first 10m. If we see 429s, we'll throttle the test. Config snippet to use posted below.

raj-sre: ```json
{"autoscale":{"min":1,"max":25,"target_cpu_percent":60,"scale_up_window_s":90,"initial_headroom":3,"headroom_duration_s":600}}
```

shelly-ops: Load harness ready. Command: `./tools/loadgen --scenario stonehaven-warm --rps 60 --duration 1800 --model rdx-5b-serve-v2 --token_dist small` I'll trigger CI job `ci/warm-stonehaven.yaml`.

tom-eng: Reminder: prefix cache priming for top-20 intents. I will run the priming job 30m before start. Do not alter model flags during the run.

maya-cs: Pre-run checklist (reply with ack):
- quota bump applied and visible
- KMS & logging enabled
- notify oncall SRE
- prefix cache primed
- smoke test success (single request)

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `warm-stonehaven-1719950000`. Will post status.

anita-billing: Acked quota visible in billing portal.

raj-sre: I'll be on the SRE desk 08:40-10:40 PT. Abort rules reiterated: abort if 5xx > 3% for 2m OR p99 > 2s for 5m. We'll also watch token consumption and 429s.

tom-eng: After the run, I'll paste short runbook + raw metrics. Expected ballpark: requests ~ 540k, p50 ~ 110ms, p90 ~ 300ms, p99 ~ 950ms, errors <1%. Peak replicas ~ 14.

shelly-ops: Kicking off priming job at 08:25 PT. CI job queued. Will post when load starts and when finished with artifacts (logs, grafana snapshot, csv latency).

maya-cs: Please keep updates brief. RC (review call) at 10:30 PT to decide sign-off and any follow-ups for renewal enablement notes.

tom-eng: Noted. One quick ask from Stonehaven: they want a short performance note and recommended autoscale params for their app-level orchestrator after the warmup. I'll draft in the RC.

shelly-ops: Load running now. Hitting 60 r/s shadow. No errors so far.

deploy-bot: Job `warm-stonehaven-1719950000` status: running.

shelly-ops: Transitioning to ramp phase. Moving to 300 r/s over 12m.

raj-sre: Observing p99 ~ 1.05s, errors 0.8%, CPU avg ~ 57%, replicas scaling to 10. All within guardrails so far.

shelly-ops: Run complete. Artifacts uploaded: `s3://redwood-warmups/stonehaven/1719950000/{latency.csv,summary.json,grafana.png}`

tom-eng: Post-run summary:
requests: 540112
p50: 108ms
p90: 298ms
p99: 990ms
errors: 0.9%
peak_replicas: 14
avg_cpu: 59%
notes: prefix cache reduced kv misses by estimated 22%.

raj-sre: SRE sign-off: within SLA and guardrails. Recommend final autoscale policy for customer: min=2,max=18,target_cpu=62,burst_headroom=2 for first 5m.

maya-cs: Thanks all. Anita, I'll add the billing note and quote warmup token usage in the renewal packet. Tom, please file the short performance doc and include recommended autoscale params.

anita-billing: I'll include the token usage note. All set from finance.

maya-cs: RC at 10:30 PT went well, sign-off granted. Closing thread. :checkered_flag:
